The '''Gunners''' are an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]''. ''

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:MachineGunGuyL.gif|80px]]

First appearing in [[Death Valley|Act 2-2]], Gunners are similar to [[Knife Man|Knife Men]], but more active. Gunners slowly move forward and backward, but with every second, they stop to machine-gun-fire 3 bullets forward. If not killed quickly, they can be very effective campers. Both their contact and bullet attacks do 1 damage, and they are best defeated using sub-weapons like the [[Shuriken]] to take them out before they start firing.
